tools.name: purge_expired_trials
tools.description: Finds trial subscriptions that ended more than the given number of days ago without converting, revokes their entitlements with the billing CLI, and permanently deletes the subscription records. With dry_run set, it only lists the matching trials.

params.name: days_expired
params.description: Minimum number of days since the trial ended

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, only report matching trials without revoking or deleting

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of trials to process

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("subscriptions")

DB_PATH = "subscriptions.db"
BILLING_CLI = "billing-cli"


def _revoke_entitlements(subscription_id: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [BILLING_CLI, "entitlements", "revoke", "--subscription", subscription_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    return proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr.strip()


@mcp.tool()
def purge_expired_trials(days_expired: int, dry_run: bool = False, limit: int = 100) -> dict:
    cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=days_expired)).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, customer_id, plan_id, trial_ends_at FROM subscriptions "
            "WHERE status = 'trial_expired' AND converted = 0 AND trial_ends_at < ? "
            "ORDER BY trial_ends_at LIMIT ?",
            (cutoff, limit),
        ).fetchall()
        matched = [dict(r) for r in rows]
        if dry_run:
            return {"dry_run": True, "matched": matched, "deleted": [], "failed": []}

        deleted = []
        failed = []
        for row in matched:
            ok, err = _revoke_entitlements(row["id"])
            if not ok:
                failed.append({"id": row["id"], "error": err})
                continue
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM subscriptions WHERE id = ?", (row["id"],))
            deleted.append(row["id"])
        conn.commit()
        return {"dry_run": False, "matched": matched, "deleted": deleted, "failed": failed}
    finally:
        conn.close()

tools.name: transfer_subscription_ownership
tools.description: Transfers a subscription to a new owner account, updating the stored owner and billing contact, and notifies the new owner through the notifications service.

params.name: subscription_id
params.description: ID of the subscription to transfer

params.name: new_owner_id
params.description: User ID of the new owner

params.name: new_owner_email
params.description: Email address of the new owner to notify

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("subscriptions")

NOTIFY_URL = "https://notifications.internal.example.com/v1/send"


@dataclass
class TransferResult:
    subscription_id: str
    new_owner_id: str
    updated: bool
    notified: bool


@mcp.tool()
def transfer_subscription_ownership(subscription_id: str, new_owner_id: str, new_owner_email: str) -> TransferResult:
    with sqlite3.connect("subscriptions.db") as conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE subscriptions SET owner_id = ?, billing_email = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (new_owner_id, new_owner_email, subscription_id),
        )
    updated = cur.rowcount > 0
    resp = requests.post(
        NOTIFY_URL,
        json={"to": new_owner_email, "template": "subscription_transferred", "subscription_id": subscription_id},
        timeout=10,
    ) if updated else None
    return TransferResult(subscription_id, new_owner_id, updated, bool(resp and resp.ok))

tools.name: archive_cancelled_plan_export
tools.description: Validates a cancelled-plan export file by running the validation script on it, then moves it into the archive folder. The file is only moved if validation succeeds.

params.name: export_path
params.description: Path to the cancelled-plan export file

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def archive_cancelled_plan_export(export_path: str, archive_dir: str) -> str:
    src = Path(export_path)
    dest_dir = Path(archive_dir)
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        staged = Path(tmp) / src.name
        shutil.copy2(src, staged)
        check = subprocess.run(["python", "scripts/validate_export.py", str(staged)], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if check.returncode != 0:
            return f"Validation failed: {check.stderr.strip()}"
    target = shutil.move(str(src), str(dest_dir / src.name))
    return f"Archived to {target}"
